# Ryan Schmidt
## Senior SaaS Product Designer

> Ryan Schmidt is a CX/UX designer at i4cp focused on information architecture,
> member experience, and AI-augmented product UX. He turns messy research and
> legacy interfaces into systems that scale, with measurable outcomes like task
> success, component reuse, and adoption. Strengths sit at the seam of design
> and engineering: token-first design systems, prototyping in code, and AI
> tooling like Cursor and Claude. Based in Austin, TX.

## Specialties

- Information Architecture
- Design Systems (token-first)
- AI-augmented Product UX
- Member Experience
- Design + Engineering Collaboration

## Ask the portfolio AI

An AI chat widget powered by Gemini is available on every page. It can answer
questions about Ryan's background, case studies, working style, and fit for
specific roles. The knowledge base includes anti-hallucination policy, outcome
metrics, and structured fit-matching. Endpoint: /api/chat (POST).

## Case studies

- [Custom Dashboards & AI Summaries](https://ryanschmidt.design/pages/dashboard)
  Operational dashboard surfacing high-frequency tasks and customizable views.
  Outcomes: +71% sustained dashboard views, 62% multi-dashboard adoption.

- [Inventory, Purchasing & Receiving](https://ryanschmidt.design/pages/inventory)
  Connected purchasing, receiving, and stock tracking in one workflow.
  Outcomes: Contributed to an 8% increase in recurring revenue and 8% year-over-year adoption growth.

- [Building My Portfolio in Code](https://ryanschmidt.design/pages/ai-coding-portfolio)
  Portfolio rebuilt from scratch in semantic HTML, modular CSS, and JavaScript with AI coding tools.
  Outcomes: fully custom site, reusable UI and code patterns, assistant connected to project notes.

- [i4cp Member Portal & Research Discovery](https://ryanschmidt.design/pages/member-portal-overhaul)
  Research-led navigation and IA overhaul for an enterprise HR research portal.
  Outcomes: Shipped September 11, 2026; +500% Ahri sessions and doubled daily activity.
